::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/reminders"}
#docs
Lead times in days for `trial_ending`, `renewal_reminder`, `cancellation_reminder`, `payment_due_reminder`, `pause_reminder`, `resume_reminder`, `card_expiring` and `pre_debit_notification`, for this business. The first three come from the business's `reminder_config` (each row's `configurable` is true); the pre-debit notice is fixed and a MINIMUM rather than a target: NPCI/RBI require the payer be told at least 24h before a mandate debit, so its window carries margin for a delayed tick.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_reminder_schedule`. One of `email_reminder_schedule`. |
| `configurable` | `boolean` | Whether the reminder schedule can be changed. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The reminder emails and when they go out. |
| `data.type` | `string` | The reminder's email type. |
| `data.days_before` | `integer` | The largest lead day: the first reminder. Null when the reminder is off. |
| `data.expiry_month` | `boolean` | card_expiring only: true when the notice goes out in the card's expiry month instead of on lead days. |
| `data.lead_days` | `array of integer` | Every lead day, largest first. |
| `data.yearly_days_before` | `integer` | renewal_reminder only: the largest lead day on yearly plans. |
| `data.yearly_lead_days` | `array of integer` | renewal_reminder only: every lead day on yearly plans. |
| `data.configurable` | `boolean` | Whether `reminder_config` on the business sets this row. False for the pre-debit notice. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business |
